newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila oil group in farm-in with Australia Socdet.
newsitem.headline: Manila oil group in farm-in with Australia Socdet.

text.p: Philippine oil exploration group led by Alcorn (Production) Philippines Inc said on Tuesday it was signing a farm-in agreement with Australia based Socdet Production Pty Ltd.

The signing scheduled for later today will give Socdet a 35 percent stake in Alcorn's Service Contract covering northwest Palawan once it conducts a $6-million worth seismic survey late this year or early 1997.
In a letter to Energy Minister Francisco Viray, a copy of which was given to Reuters, Alcorn said Socdet would get a further 25 percent stake if it decided to drill a well.
Farm-in agreements have to be approved by the Energy Department.

Members of the Alcorn consortium are Alcorn Palawan Inc Philodrill Corp, TransAsia Oil and Mineral Development Corp, Balabac Oil Exploration and Drilling Co, Unioil and Gas Development Co Inc, Basic Petroleum and Minerals Inc, Alcorn Production and Minerals Corp and Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp.
